title: Derived pullback, tensor product, and internal Hom
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\Ql$
[def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension] with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and
uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and for $n\in\mathbf Z_{\geq1}$ put
$A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility].
Let $X,Y$ be schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible and let $f:X\to Y$ be a
morphism [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Use the small pro-etale sites
[def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]; for $W\in\{X,Y\}$ and a ring $A$, $A_W$ is the
constant coefficient sheaf and $D(W_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ the derived category of
$A_W$-modules. Let $f^{-1}$ be the inverse image of pro-etale sheaves along $f$
[def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]; it is exact and $f^{-1}A_Y=A_X$, and $f_n$
denotes $f$ regarded as the morphism of ringed sites
$(X_{\mathrm{proet}},(A_{E,n})_X)\to(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},(A_{E,n})_Y)$.

**Finite level.** Put $A=A_{E,n}$. For $K\in D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$, $W\in\{X,Y\}$
and $M,N\in D(W_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ define

$$
 Lf_n^*K=L(f_n)^*K=f^{-1}K\otimes^L_{f^{-1}A_Y}A_X,
 \qquad
 M\otimes_A^L N,
 \qquad
 R\mathcal Hom_A(M,N):
$$

the first is the derived module pullback [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations],
computed with a K-flat resolution; since $f^{-1}$ is exact and
$f^{-1}A_Y=A_X$ it is $f^{-1}$ applied termwise to any representative of $K$.
The second is the derived tensor product [def-weil-derived-tensor], computed
with a K-flat resolution of $M$. The third is the derived internal Hom
[def-pur-derived-internal-hom] of the ringed site $(W_{\mathrm{proet}},A_W)$,
computed with a K-injective resolution of $N$. These are functors on the
ambient categories $D(-_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})$; which of them preserve the
constructible subcategories $D^b_c(-,A_{E,n})$
[def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility] is not part of this definition.

**Integral level** ($\Lambda=\mathcal O_E$). On the derived-complete integral
categories $D^b_c(W,\mathcal O_E)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed],
full subcategories of the derived category $D(W_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$ of
modules over the completed coefficient sheaf $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}$
[def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], $Lf^*$,
$\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}$ and $R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_E}$ are the integral
derived operations [def-pur-integral-derived-operations]: the derived inverse
limits

$$
 Lf^*K=R\varprojlim_n\operatorname{Res}_nLf_n^*\bigl(K\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n}\bigr),
 \qquad
 M\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}N=R\varprojlim_n\operatorname{Res}_n
 \bigl((M\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n})\otimes^L_{A_{E,n}}(N\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n})\bigr)
$$

of the compatible finite reductions [def-weil-derived-limit], and the derived
internal Hom of $(W_{\mathrm{proet}},\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W})$. The K-flat and
K-injective resolutions are taken in the ambient category of
$\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}$-modules; a resolution is not required to remain in
$D^b_c(W,\mathcal O_E)$ term by term. By
[lem-pur-integral-operations-preserve-constructible], $Lf^*$ carries
$D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)$ into $D^b_c(X,\mathcal O_E)$ and
$\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}$ carries $D^b_c(W,\mathcal O_E)^2$ into
$D^b_c(W,\mathcal O_E)$. The internal Hom $R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_E}(M,N)$ is
taken as an operation of $D^b_c(W,\mathcal O_E)$ only for the pairs $M,N$ for
which it lies in $D^b_c(W,\mathcal O_E)$.

**Rational level** ($\Lambda=E$). On
$D^b_c(W,E)=D^b_c(W,\mathcal O_E)[1/\varpi_E]$ [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi],
whose objects are those of $D^b_c(W,\mathcal O_E)$, each operation $F$ is the
integral one on objects, and on morphisms
$\operatorname{Hom}(K,K')\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}E$ it sends $u\otimes c$ to
$F(u)\otimes c$ (contravariantly in the first variable of
$R\mathcal Hom$); write $Lf_E^*$, $\otimes^L_E$, $R\mathcal Hom_E$.

**Algebraically closed level** ($\Lambda=\Qlb$). In the common-stage
categories $\mathcal C_W$ of pairs $(E,K)$ with $K\in D^b_c(W,E)$
[def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], with $EE'$ the compositum in
$\Qlb$ [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set], put

$$
 Lf^*(E,K)=(E,Lf_E^*K),\qquad
 (E,M)\otimes(E',N)=\bigl(EE',(M\otimes_EEE')\otimes^L_{EE'}(N\otimes_{E'}EE')\bigr),
$$
$$
 R\mathcal Hom((E,M),(E',N))=\bigl(EE',R\mathcal Hom_{EE'}(M\otimes_EEE',N\otimes_{E'}EE')\bigr)
$$

(the last for the pairs whose integral internal Hom at stage $EE'$ is
constructible). A morphism represented by $u$ over a common finite extension
$L$ is sent to the class over $L$ of the same operation applied to $u$,
composed on both sides with the scalar-extension isomorphisms
$F_{E}(K)\otimes_EL\cong F_L(K\otimes_EL)$ of
[lem-pur-integral-operations-scalar-extension].

mathlib_searches.results: the small pro-étale site `Scheme.ProEt` (Sites/Proetale.lean:100) and `SheafOfModules.pullback` for a continuous functor of sites (PullbackContinuous.lean:53); no pro-étale functoriality in morphisms of schemes and no derived pullback

`PresheafOfModules.Monoidal.monoidalCategory` (presheaf tensor product, Presheaf/Monoidal.lean:125); abstract `Functor.totalLeftDerived` (LeftDerived.lean:193); `DerivedCategory C` (DerivedCategory/Basic.lean:87) carries no monoidal or closed structure; no derived tensor product or derived internal Hom of sheaves of modules

split_report.summary: Checked the statement against the blueprint (master; slopmaster2 has no copy of this node; Lean state none on both branches) and against Bhatt-Scholze 3.4.10-3.4.11, 6.5.3-6.5.9 and Stacks 099N, 08J7, 06YV, 09A5. Rewrote the statement to say the same thing precisely: the blueprint mixed two readings of the integral case (resolutions over the completed sheaf vs. 'derived inverse limit of the compatible finite reductions'); it is now pullback and tensor as derived limits of the finite reductions (Bhatt-Scholze's completed pullback and completed tensor product), internal Hom as the ambient internal Hom over the completed sheaf, as in Bhatt-Scholze. Made explicit the rational (Hom tensor E) and common-stage constructions the blueprint only named, and that integral internal Hom is an operation of D^b_c only on pairs where it lands in D^b_c (for general schemes it need not). Added the statement dependencies the notions use: inverse image f^{-1} (new), module pullback (existing def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations), derived internal Hom (new), completed coefficients, derived limit, the coefficient field, the compositum, the integral operations (new), and the two lemmas the definition needs to be well defined on D^b_c and on the common-stage category (new: preservation of constructibility, compatibility with finite scalar extension). (Lead, review: the new node def-pur-proetale-inverse-image duplicated def-weil-proetale-inverse-image, created the same day by the split of def-weil-constant-weil-structure; the duplicate was dropped before commit and the citation repointed.)
